name: Delta SkyMiles Reserve Business American Express Card

loungeAccess.network: Delta Sky Club + Amex Centurion Lounges
otherLounges: Delta Sky Club: unlimited visits when flying Delta-marketed/operated flights
American Express Centurion Lounges: access when flying Delta
loungeAccess.notes: Delta Sky Club: unlimited visits for cardholder (as of recent policy, complimentary guest access may be limited — check current Delta policy). You may bring guests at $50/person per visit. Centurion Lounge access available when flying Delta same day.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $20,000 every 12 months across all claims.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard published benefit on the Delta Reserve Business.

emergencyMedical.notes: Premium Global Assist: 24/7 emergency medical evacuation coordination at no cost for transport. Does NOT cover medical treatment costs.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary rental car insurance. Decline the rental company's CDW. Up to 30 consecutive days.

otherCredits.name: First Checked Bag Free
otherCredits.notes: First checked bag free for you and up to 8 companions on the same reservation on Delta-operated flights.

otherCredits.name: Domestic Companion Certificate
otherCredits.notes: Annual domestic Main Cabin round-trip companion certificate upon card renewal. Certificate valid for round-trip travel in Main Cabin within the contiguous US (taxes and fees apply, from ~$22.40).

otherCredits.name: Upgrade Certificates
otherCredits.notes: Complimentary companion certificate and upgrade certificates; specific terms vary by year. Check current Delta cardmember benefits.

otherCredits.name: Delta SkyMiles Medallion Qualification Miles (MQM) Boost
otherCredits.notes: Earn Medallion Qualification Dollars (MQDs) toward Delta status. Spend $30,000 and receive 15,000 Medallion Qualifying Miles and qualification for Silver Medallion Status consideration (check current MQD rules as Delta updated status criteria in 2024).

otherCredits.name: Statement Credit for Delta Purchases
otherCredits.notes: No specific annual credit for Delta purchases — miles earn at bonus rate instead.

rewards.baseRate: 1x Delta SkyMiles per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 3x Delta SkyMiles on Delta purchases; 1.5x on eligible transit and commuting
otherBonusCategories: 3x miles on Delta purchases (tickets, Sky Club memberships, in-flight)
1.5x miles on eligible U.S. shipping purchases

pointValue.transferPartners: Delta SkyMiles — use on Delta flights and partner airlines (Air France/KLM, Virgin Atlantic, Korean Air, etc.). No airline partners for direct transfers; SkyMiles are earned through card spending only.

travelPerks: Unlimited Delta Sky Club access when flying Delta
Centurion Lounge access when flying Delta
First checked bag free (you + up to 8 companions)
Premium Global Assist — emergency evacuation coordination
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
20% savings on inflight purchases (as statement credit)
Earn toward Delta Medallion Status through spending
bestFor: Loyal Delta flyers who want unlimited Sky Club access, free checked bags, and a companion certificate each year to offset the annual fee
